products.title: WARNING: Habit-Forming Premium Golf Tees
products.body_html:
This pack of 20 Premium Après-Golf Tees swaps smokes for strokes.

WARNING:  Après-Golf is habit-forming.  Side effects may include pleasure during or after your round.  Call a friend if you begin to suffer withdrawals after 18 holes.  Always remember to find your line.

*These are great for bachelor parties and events.  Hit us up if you've got a trip or outing in the works!

products.body_html:
Epic socks made by our friends at Del Campo Golf!

We know that après-golf can sometimes last a little longer than planned.  Might as well treat your feet to some extra comfort both on and off the course with these socks.

- S/M fit US men sizes 5-8.5 and women sizes 6-10
- M/L fit US men sizes 9-13 and women sizes 10-15

products.title: Après-Golf® Pouch Stash Case
products.body_html:
Après-Golf ®  is for like-minded golfers who enjoy the camaraderie of family and friends after their round just as much as the round itself. 

We teamed up with American Made manufacturer and Veteran Owned SMF Prints to create these stash cases.  Perfect for your zynnies, lozenges...or anything else to keep you focused on the course and beyond.

products.title: Après-Golf® Sticker Pack
products.body_html:
The ultimate 3-pack of stickers!

Our infamous "I'd rather be at Après-Golf ®" and "Follow me to Après-Golf ®" bumper stickers are heavy duty interior/exterior weatherproof material.  With a measurement coming in at 11" x 3" you'll definitely be able to find some friends. 

Smaller "scratch logo" sticker measures 4" x 1.25" and is perfect for water bottles, coolers, beverage fridges and beyond.

Après-Golf ® is for like-minded golfers who enjoy the camaraderie of family and friends after their round just as much as the round itself.
